about: Round 1558. The two host proof behind nflconn-004, the one NFL Connections board the checker flagged: Le'Veon Bell, listed with the Steelers, also played five games for Baltimore in 2021, beside the board's Ravens group. The record (nflConnectionsRecord-2026-10.json, ESPN's athlete service) is one host; nfl.com's career page is the second (statmuse.com for a kicker, whose nfl.com page carries no table). Wikis are never a source.
rules: A fact names a man, a group label and whether he fits it (holds), and carries two sources on two different hosts, neither a wiki: the record first, the second host after it.
Every member of a group the checker flagged before the round holds his group on two hosts (flaggedGroups lists those groups under their labels after the round).
Every finding the checker made before the round (fixed) has the fact behind it on two hosts: the member who did not fit, or the man from another group who did.
uncheckedCeiling, memberUnknownCeiling and otherUnknownCeiling may only fall: a label, a member or another tile the record cannot judge must not come back.
